title: אדא בר מניומי
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: Adda bar Minyomi spoke to Ravina. Anonymous “judges of Nehardea” means Rav Adda bar Minyomi (see there). He explained it before Ravina, Bava Kamma 31b; and Huna Mar bar Idi, Chullin 49a. One forbade, the other permitted, because both sat in the study hall, Tosafot, Avodah Zarah 7a. See Acha bar Minyomi: perhaps his brother, or the same person. This seems supported by the Gemara’s Acha bar Minyomi, “judges of Nehardea” (see there).
